philosophy.title: One operator. Four companies. One standard.
philosophy.lede: A holding only earns the name when it runs what it owns.

principles.title: Build, don't resell.
principles.body: Every subsidiary is built and run to the same engineering standard. No outsourced core, no white-labelled product — the hard parts are ours.

principles.title: Bits and material.
principles.body: Operating-system kernels and autonomous agents on one side, furniture and architecture on the other. We build the hard things — whether they ship in code or in material.

principles.title: Honesty over hype.
principles.body: Our AI agents reason inside sandboxes and self-debug under a microscope. We build for verifiable truth, not for demos.

items.body: We fund the companies we run — capital aligned to engineering, not to a pitch deck.
Kernels, agents, dashboards, and the furniture and rooms around them — built to one standard, ours.
We don't flip what we build. We run our companies for the long term.

cta.title: Building something hard?
cta.body: If your work is hard to copy — a kernel, a fleet, an agent, or a building — we'd like to hear about it.

footer.tagline: One operator. Four companies. One standard.
footer.donot: © 2026 Daniel Limón Holdings. All rights reserved.

about.title: I'm Daniel Limón.
about.lede: An engineer who decided to run what he builds. Because people deserve the best.
about.body1: I work on almost all the hard things you can imagine, from operating-system to an studio that builds the furniture and architecture around them. I don't buy equity in other people's companies and I don't relabel other people's work, if my name is on it, I built it and I operate it.
about.body2: I think a holding only earns the name when it runs what it owns. So that's what this is: one operator, four companies, held to one standard. Not flipped, not resold, not pitched to a deck.
about.body3: I fund the companies I run, I ship the parts that are hardest, and I stay on them. Capital aligned to engineering, not to a pitch. The hard parts are mine; the long term is the point.
